node.statement: For this local derivation, the phrase A is an atlas on M defining its manifold structure is expanded as follows: A is a family of coordinate charts (U,phi) whose domains satisfy (i) U is open in M for every (U,phi) in A and (ii) M is the union of those domains. This line introduces the explicit local expansion of the phrase used in node 1.1.1.2; it invokes no external theorem.
